paragraphs: Friend, here's the big idea. Jesus doesn't fix a troubled heart by explaining the plan. He fixes it by pointing to Himself. "I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me." (John 14:6) The way home isn't a map you figure out. It's a Person you follow.

And look at what this Person gives. He says He's going to prepare a place and will come back to welcome them into His presence (John 14:2-3). He promises another Advocate, the Spirit of truth, who will be with them forever (John 14:16-17). He says, "I will not leave you as orphans; I will come to you." (John 14:18) I spent years in the back of a drawer, so I'm telling you, nobody who belongs to Jesus gets left in the dark.

So what do you do with that? You love Him, and loving Him looks like keeping His word (John 14:15, 23). The Holy Spirit will teach you and remind you of what Jesus said (John 14:26). Then Jesus gives a peace that isn't like what the world gives, and says, "Do not let your hearts be troubled; do not be afraid." (John 14:27) Carry that into your day, baker, and keep that oven warm.
